about: Hand-written sample table behind findings.md section 2. 34 donors from the Ethics Commission 2026 top-contributor tables and press. Class A = donor's own statement about a local-government issue at a stable URL; B = own statement of general (non-local) priorities, or a first-party source seen only via a third party; C = third-party material only; D = nothing found. 'Nothing found' reflects a shallow search, not proof none exists. listed_usd is the sum of the figures given for the donor in the frame in findings.md section 1 (null where the frame gives none); it is not a computed ranking. basis: 'opened' = page fetched and read; 'excerpt' = only a search-result excerpt seen; 'third_party' = no first-party page seen.
